children: AerCap Funding Designated Activity Company, a wholly-owned subsidiary of AerCap

, on Wednesday priced an offering of senior notes, consisting of a $750M aggregate principal amount of the issuer's 5.500% senior notes due 2030 and a $750M aggregate principal amount of the issuer's 5.875% senior notes due 2033.
The notes will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by the company and certain other subsidiaries of the company.
The issuer intends to use the net proceeds from the Notes for general corporate purposes, including to acquire, invest in, finance, or refinance aircraft assets and to repay indebtedness.
Citigroup, Mizuho, BNP PARIBAS, Deutsche Bank Securities, Santander, and Truist Securities are serving as joint book-running managers for the underwritten public offering, the company stated.
